## Purpose
What behavior changes, and why?

## Changes
Describe the final behavior and source documents used. Link screenshots or artifacts for visible changes.

## Validation
Commands run, results, and any limits. Distinguish actual recorded playback from timing simulations.

## Risks and source changes
State clinical source, sequencing, timing, media, or compatibility impact. Say explicitly when there is none.

## Ownership
Use `scripts/agents.py claim` to attach the task/agent/branch/scope contract. Do not remove its hidden JSON block.
